public.title: Subtree of Another Tree
public.description: Return whether the second tree equals the complete subtree rooted at some node of the first, including values and shape. The empty tree is a subtree of every tree. A nonempty tree is not a subtree of an empty tree. Trees use compact breadth-first arrays: read the root, then left and right child slots for each non-null node in queue order. null marks a missing child; absent trailing slots are null. [] is empty. Values are integers from -10000 to 10000 and there are at most 200 nodes.
hints: A candidate root must match the full shape, not merely the values it contains.
Try matching at every node of the larger tree.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Check structural equality at each possible root. O(nm) worst-case time and O(h) recursion space.
